err.400.title: Security check failed
err.400.text: Your request could not be verified (missing or invalid CSRF token). Please reload the page and try again.
err.403.title: Access denied
err.403.text: You do not have permission to use this feature. Please contact an administrator.
err.404.title: Page not found
err.404.text: The address may be wrong, or the page was moved or deleted.
err.500.title: Something went wrong
err.500.text: An internal error occurred. Please try again; if it keeps happening, tell an administrator.
cap.no_nmap.text: nmap was not found in PATH — scanning is unavailable
cap.not_admin.text: Not running as Administrator/root — OS detection and MAC addresses may be incomplete
cap.not_admin.tip: Scanning works at full capability only when the program runs with Administrator or root rights. Without those rights, OS detection and device MAC addresses may be incomplete.
cap.no_npcap.text: Npcap was not found — nmap will use ping instead of ARP and may miss devices that block ping
refusal.gentle_limit: Gentle scan is limited to {max} addresses (a /22); this target has {n}. Use a smaller range or untick the option.
refusal.udp_limit: UDP scan is limited to {max} addresses (a /26); this target has {n}. Use a smaller range or untick the option.
refusal.all_ports_limit: Scan all ports (1-65535) is limited to {max} addresses (a /26); this target has {n}. Use a smaller range or untick the option.
run.note.not_admin: This scan ran without Administrator/root rights — devices that block ping may be missed, and MAC addresses or OS details may be incomplete.
run.note.no_npcap: Npcap was not found during this scan — nmap used ping instead of ARP and may have missed devices that block ping.
run.note.skip_no_evidence: {n} address(es) with no response were omitted as devices — hosts blocking all ports cannot be told apart from unused addresses.
run.note.suggest_pn: {n} IP(s) did not reply and may be blocking ping — scan again with "Skip ping (-Pn)" to probe ports directly.
run.note.host_probes: Sent common-port and ICMP probes for hosts ignoring ping. On the same subnet nmap already uses ARP, so this only changes results beyond a router.
run.note.gentle: Gentle scan: sent packets slowly with rate limits and at most 2 retries, taking much longer than usual; dropped packets may leave ports shown as filtered.
run.note.udp: Second pass scanned 12 common UDP ports (53, 67, 69, 123, 137, 161, 500, 520, 623, 1434, 1900, 5060) on online hosts. Silent UDP ports show as open|filtered (not confirmed open) and are excluded from CVE lookups.
run.note.udp_failed: The UDP pass did not succeed, so this scan has no UDP port results. TCP results were not affected.
run.note.udp_failed_cause: The UDP pass did not succeed, so this scan has no UDP port results. TCP results were not affected (cause: {cause}).
run.note.udp_not_scanned: {n} host(s) were skipped for UDP (non-IPv4 or not reported by nmap), so their UDP ports are unknown.
run.note.udp_timed_out: {n} host(s) exceeded the 10-minute UDP limit and were skipped by nmap, so their UDP ports are unknown.
run.note.no_dns: DNS name lookup was skipped (-n), so a missing hostname does not mean the host has none (NetBIOS names queried directly can still appear).
run.note.all_ports: Scanned all TCP ports 1-65535 on each host. Only individually reported ports are listed; the rest are summarised by nmap as totals per state (usually closed or filtered).
run.note.timed_out: {n} host(s) exceeded the 45-minute limit and were skipped by nmap, so their ports are unknown (not necessarily none open).
run.note.arp_only: The local ARP cache knew {n} other device(s) in this range that did not respond during the scan (recent local traffic; may be stale).
job_err.interrupted: Interrupted: the application restarted while this scan was waiting or running.
job_err.time_limit: Scan stopped: it ran longer than its time limit ({limit}).

ai.local.bad_engine: Choose either Gemini or the local model.
ai.local.bad_url: Not a valid address. It must be an address of the computer that runs the app, for example http://127.0.0.1:11434.
ai.local.bad_model: Not a valid model name (English letters, digits and . _ : / @ - only).
ai.local.bad_layers: The layer count must be a whole number from 0 to {max}, or empty.
ai.local.err.unreachable: The local model cannot be reached. Please check that Ollama is running (if it was just started, wait a moment) and ask again. This question was not sent to Gemini instead.
ai.local.err.timeout: The local model did not answer in time. If Ollama was just started, wait 1 to 2 minutes (the first start loads the model slowly) and ask again. If it still fails, it may be short of memory, or the question may be too long.
ai.local.err.model_missing: Ollama does not have this model. A superadmin can check the model name in Settings.
ai.local.err.not_ollama: The saved address is not an Ollama server. A superadmin can check it in Settings.
ai.local.err.bad_answer: The local model sent an answer that could not be read. Please try again.
ai.local.err.empty: The local model gave no answer, possibly because it used all its tokens on thinking. Please ask a shorter question or try again.
ai.local.err.other: The local model call failed (code {code}). Please try again.
ai.local.probe.ok: Connected, and the model {model} was found
ai.local.probe.gpu: · {gpu}% of the model is on the GPU now
ai.local.probe.model_missing: Connected, but Ollama does not have the model {model}. Download it with the command ollama pull {model}, or choose an installed model from the list.
ai.local.probe.unreachable: Cannot reach Ollama. Please check that the Ollama program is running, press Test again, and check that the address is right.
ai.local.probe.timeout: Ollama did not answer in time. If the computer or Ollama was just started, wait 1 to 2 minutes and press Test again. If it still fails, try closing the Ollama program and starting it again.
ai.local.probe.not_ollama: This address answered, but it is not an Ollama server. Please check the address (normally http://127.0.0.1:11434).
chat.busy: Several questions are still waiting for an answer. Please wait for them to finish before asking again.
chat.answer_start_failed: The system could not start answering. Please try again.
chat.truncated: The answer was longer than the limit, so it was cut off before the end. Please ask something more specific, or ask for it in parts.
